roleTitle: Staff Development Coordinator / Infection Control Nurse (RN)
description: Join a dedicated team at a leading skilled nursing facility in Oakland, MD, as a Staff Development Coordinator / Infection Control Nurse (RN). This pivotal role offers the unique opportunity to shape the clinical competency of our nursing staff while safeguarding the health and well-being of our residents through robust infection prevention strategies.In this dual capacity, you will be instrumental in developing and implementing comprehensive educational programs, ensuring all staff meet and exceed professional standards. Concurrently, you will lead our infection control initiatives, conducting surveillance, developing policies, and providing critical education to prevent the spread of infections within our community.We are seeking a passionate and experienced RN to fill this vital full-time position, offering a competitive hourly rate of $40-$42. If you are ready to make a significant impact on both staff development and resident safety, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Active and unrestricted Registered Nurse (RN) license
Minimum of 2 years of experience in a long-term care setting
Demonstrated experience in staff education, training, or development
Proven experience in infection prevention and control practices
Strong understanding of state and federal regulations for skilled nursing facilities
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive hourly rate of $40-$42, based on experience.

description: We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Marketing Director to join a premier health and rehabilitation center in Sarasota County, FL. This leadership role is crucial for driving census growth and enhancing the facility's presence within the community. The ideal candidate will be instrumental in developing and executing comprehensive marketing strategies to attract new residents and maintain strong relationships with referral sources.This is a unique opportunity for a proactive and results-driven professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment. The role requires a professional demeanor, the ability to work occasional weekends, and a commitment to achieving ambitious goals. We are prepared to offer excellent compensation for the right individual who can demonstrate a proven track record of success in healthcare marketing.
requirements: Proven experience as a Marketing Director, preferably within a skilled nursing or healthcare setting
Demonstrated ability to develop and implement effective marketing strategies
Professional demeanor and excellent communication skills
Ability to work occasional weekends as needed
Proactive and results-driven approach to market development and community outreach
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation based on experience and performance.

description:
Join a dedicated team at a premier health and rehabilitation center in Inverness, FL, as a Per Diem Physical Therapist. This PRN role offers the flexibility to work on an as-needed basis, providing essential therapy services to patients recovering from illness, injury, or surgery. You will play a crucial role in helping individuals regain their independence and improve their quality of life.

As a Physical Therapist, you will be responsible for assessing patients, developing individualized treatment plans, and implementing therapeutic interventions. This is an excellent opportunity for a compassionate and skilled therapist looking for flexible work while making a significant impact on patient outcomes. We are seeking a professional who is committed to delivering high-quality, patient-centered care.
requirements: Current Physical Therapist (PT) license in the state of Florida
Graduation from an accredited Physical Therapy program
Previous experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation facility preferred
Ability to work flexible PRN shifts as needed
salaryOrBonusInfo: Physical Therapists (PT) can expect an hourly rate of $39.00 - $40.00, based on experience.

description:
We are seeking a dedicated and compassionate Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) for a PRN opportunity in Inverness, FL. This role offers the flexibility to work as needed, providing essential support to patients on their journey to recovery and improved mobility within a premier health and rehabilitation center. Join a team committed to delivering high-quality, patient-centered care.

As a PRN PTA, you will work under the supervision of a licensed Physical Therapist, implementing treatment plans, documenting patient progress, and ensuring a safe and therapeutic environment. This is an excellent opportunity for a skilled professional looking for flexible hours and a competitive hourly rate.
requirements: Associate's degree from an accredited Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) program.
Current state licensure as a Physical Therapist Assistant (PTA) in Florida.
Prior experience in a skilled nursing or rehabilitation setting is preferred.
salaryOrBonusInfo: Competitive hourly rate of $28.00 - $37.00 based on experience.
